info.title: Lemma v2 API
info.description: REST surface derived from the Lemma v2 whitepaper SDK interface (§3, §4). v0.2 adds the 4 Bazaar Discovery Layer products under /v1/suites/* (see x-bazaar extension).

get.summary: Issuance stats for the caller's own scope
get.description: Requires an API key. The scope is resolved from the key, never from a parameter — a scope the caller could name is a scope they could snoop. `schema` narrows the result to one proof class.

Public. The running total of ZK proof verifications that succeeded, across every source: the public verification API and Seal sign-in (user registration and agent authentication). Verifications the relay rejected are not counted — the endpoint is unauthenticated, and a number that can be padded from outside is not one that can be published or anchored.
Public. The number of proofs issued on Lemma, across every scope. The counterpart to /v1/verification-count. Per-scope figures require an API key — see /v1/documents/stats.

post.summary: Agent Identity Issuance — issue a W3C VC v2 credential with Poseidon Merkle inclusion proof
post.description: For AI agents that need to issue verifiable identity credentials to other agents or services, this endpoint mints a W3C VC v2 credential with Poseidon Merkle inclusion proof and Groth16 zero-knowledge verification.

200.description: Credential issued, anchored, and ready for downstream verification

EXTENSION-RESPONSES.description: CDP facilitator processing status (status=accepted|processing|rejected). Returned only when settled via the CDP facilitator with discoverable: true.

schema.description: x402 challenge body. See @x402/core spec for shape.

post.summary: Inference Attestation API — Groth16 attestation that a given model produced a given output
post.description: For AI agents and companies running their own inference (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), this endpoint generates a Groth16 zero-knowledge attestation that proves which model produced which output, anchored on Base mainnet. Lemma never sees raw data.

200.description: Attestation generated, anchored, and ready for downstream verification

post.summary: Compliance Attestation Bundle (Basic) — BBS+ selective-disclosure proof for 2-3 standard attributes
post.description: For AI agents that need to present compliance claims (KYC status, jurisdiction, sanctions clearance) to gated endpoints without revealing underlying data, this Basic bundle returns a BBS+ selective-disclosure proof for 2-3 standard attributes per call.

200.description: Bundle generated with the requested disclosure mode

get.summary: ZK Proof Sign-in challenge — issue a single-use nonce (free, no x402)
get.description: Companion to /v1/suites/auth/proof. Returns a fresh 60-second single-use nonce that the client uses when generating the Groth16 sign-in proof. Free — payment is only required for the proof submission itself.

post.summary: ZK Proof-as-Auth (Sign-in) — verify Groth16 proof of API key possession, mint short-lived JWT
post.description: For AI agents that need to call authenticated APIs without ever holding the API key — beyond the reach of prompt injection or context leaks — this endpoint accepts a Groth16 zero-knowledge proof of API key possession and returns a short-lived JWT.

get.description: Public. Returns the latest verified snapshot of a public dataset with its provenance. Served no-cache: each read re-verifies the snapshot's proofs, advancing the public verification counter for this dataset's source. source.attribution is always present.

get.summary: Latest dataset snapshot (plain variant, no provenance)
get.description: Public control variant. Byte-identical data/source to the proof variant, with the provenance block omitted and no proof re-verification. The A/B counterpart used to isolate the effect of provenance.

issuerId.description: Issuer identifier (DID, address, or any string). Hashed to bytes32 via keccak256 for on-chain storage.

subjectId.description: Subject/holder identifier (DID, address, or any string). Hashed to bytes32 via keccak256 for on-chain storage.

disclosure.description: Opt-in disclosure access. Provide a ZK proof satisfying any condition attached to stored disclosures. Without this field, disclosures are never returned (privacy-by-default).

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1–200, default 50).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

DataProvenance.description: Provenance on a proof-variant dataset response. contentHash is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `data`; a client re-hashes and compares. docHash/registeredAt/verifyUrl are optional (present once the snapshot is registered). verifyUrl resolves to GET /v1/documents/{docHash}.

contentHash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical JSON of data

DatasetResponse.description: A verified-provenance public dataset served under the feeds suite. data/source are byte-identical across the proof and plain variants; only provenance differs. source.attribution always present (licence requirement).

product-a-input.title: Agent Identity Issuance Request
product-a-input.description: ⚠️ OUTDATED: This spec's proof model (Merkle tree) diverges from the current agent-identity.circom circuit (flat Poseidon6 commitment + issuer MAC). The circuit is the source of truth.

agentId.description: DID of the agent being credentialed (subject). Example: did:key:z6Mk...

subjectId.description: DID of the underlying real-world subject (organization, user) the agent acts on behalf of. Optional but recommended for KYA traceability.

controllerId.description: DID of the controller who can revoke this credential. Typically the issuer's operations key.

orgId.description: Organization identifier (free-form, e.g. company registration number, LEI). Used in cross-credential reconciliation.

roles.description: Roles assigned to this agent. Each role implies a baseline scope set; explicit scopes below override.

scopes.description: Fine-grained capability scopes (e.g. 'payments:send', 'data:read:financial'). Optional override over roles.

permissions.description: Boolean permission map for binary capabilities. MVP supports a fixed set; custom permissions are V2.

can_settle_x402.description: Authorize the agent to settle x402 micropayments.

can_request_attestation.description: Authorize the agent to request a Lemma attestation bundle (product C).

can_issue_subordinate.description: Authorize the agent to issue subordinate agent credentials.

can_sign_in.description: Authorize the agent to perform ZK Proof Sign-in (product D).

can_invoke_inference.description: Authorize the agent to invoke proof-anchored inference (product B).

amount.description: Maximum spend within window. String to preserve precision (USDC has 6 decimals).

currency.description: Settlement currency. MVP supports USDC only on Base mainnet. USDT/EURC are planned for V2 — passing them returns INVALID_CURRENCY in MVP.

spendLimit.description: Financial guard rail enforced at attestation-verification time by consuming services.

paymentPolicy.description: How the agent's payments are funded. MVP supports prepaid only. 'postpaid' and 'subscription' are V2 — passing them returns POLICY_NOT_SUPPORTED in MVP.

issuedAt.description: Issuance timestamp. If omitted, Lemma uses server time.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp. Maximum 1 year from issuance per MVP policy.

sourceSystem.description: Free-form identifier of the system that originated the issuance (e.g. 'aws-bedrock-agentcore', 'custom-pipeline-v2'). Stored for provenance only.

rpcUrl.description: Optional RPC endpoint reference for verifier reconciliation.

product-a-output.title: Agent Identity Issuance Response
product-a-output.description: ⚠️ OUTDATED: This spec does not reflect the current agent-identity.circom circuit, which uses a flat Poseidon6 commitment (5 sub-hashes + salt) with issuer MAC verification instead of the Merkle-tree model described here. The circuit is the source of truth; this schema is retained for API-compatibility reference only and should not be used to derive circuit inputs.

credentialId.description: Permanent identifier of the issued credential (URN form: urn:lemma:cred:<uuid>).

credential.description: W3C Verifiable Credentials v2 envelope. Subject = agentId, claims = roles+scopes+permissions+spendLimit.

@context.description: JSON-LD contexts. Always includes 'https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2' + Lemma schema context.

commitmentRoot.description: Public Poseidon Merkle root after inserting this credential's leaves (5 attributes).

leafIndex.description: Index of this credential's leaves in the Merkle tree (nLevels=20).

subjectIdHash.description: Poseidon hash of the subject DID.

merkleProofUrl.description: One-time holder-only URL to retrieve the full Merkle inclusion proof.

verifierContract.description: Address of the Solidity Groth16 verifier on Base mainnet.

requestId.description: Server-assigned request identifier for log correlation.

canonical-error.title: Lemma canonical error envelope
canonical-error.description: Shared error envelope returned by all Bazaar product endpoints (A/B/C/D) and all internal Lemma APIs.

code.description: Machine-readable upper-snake-case error code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, NONCE_EXPIRED_OR_REUSED.

message.description: Human-readable, action-oriented message. Should suggest the next step the caller can take.

field.description: Optional JSON Pointer (e.g. '/disclosure_policy/range_predicates/0/predicate') or field name pointing at the offending input.

docs.description: Optional deep link to the Lemma docs section for this error.

requestId.description: Server-assigned request identifier for log correlation.

model_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of a canonical model identifier (e.g. provider:model_name:version).

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalised inference input. Raw input is NEVER sent to Lemma.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalised inference output. Raw output is NEVER sent to Lemma.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds. Must be within ±300s of Lemma's server time (replay protection).

nonce.description: Optional 16-byte client nonce (hex) for additional replay protection.

claim_metadata.description: Optional metadata bound into the proof commitment as a hash; never stored in the clear.

agentId.description: Calling agent's DID. Recommended for full audit trail; combine with product A credential.

purpose.description: Human-readable purpose label. Hashed before commitment.

provider.description: Free-form provider identifier. Hashed before commitment.

status.description: 'anchored' = proof generated and submitted synchronously. 'deferred' = settled but queued; use pollUrl.

groth16.description: Groth16 proof tuple. null when status=deferred.

anchoredAt.description: Time the attestation was anchored on-chain. null when status=deferred.

requestId.description: Server-assigned request identifier for log correlation.

subject_did.description: DID of the subject. Must have a prior Lemma attestation set; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_ATTRIBUTES error.

requested_attributes.description: MVP Basic supports up to 3 attributes. The full 8-attribute Pro set ships in V2 at $0.20/bundle. Requesting unsupported attributes returns ATTRIBUTE_NOT_IN_BASIC_PLAN.

mode.description: full = reveal all values; selective = reveal only fields in reveal_fields; range_only = prove range without revealing values.

reveal_fields.description: Required when mode='selective'. Subset of requested_attributes.

predicate.description: BBS+ range proof supports only inclusive bounds and equality. Strict inequalities (>, <) are not supported.

verifier_context.description: Optional metadata about the verifying party. Bound into the proof for replay protection.

expires_in_seconds.description: How long the issued bundle remains valid. Default 1 hour; max 24 hours in MVP.

revealed_claims.description: Claims actually revealed per disclosure_policy (mode='full' or 'selective'). MVP Basic supports only 3 keys. Hidden claims appear as null. Empty when mode='range_only'.

range_results.description: Range predicate verification results. Present only when mode='range_only'.

requestId.description: Server-assigned request identifier for log correlation.

api_key_commitment.description: Poseidon hash of the API key, computed client-side. The API key itself is never transmitted.

zk_proof.description: Groth16 proof generated with seal-identity-v1 circuit.

nonce.description: Server-issued nonce from GET /v1/suites/auth/challenge. Single-use, expires in 60 seconds.

client_metadata.description: Optional client identification (binds to JWT for audit).

subject_type.description: Whether the sign-in is performed by a human user or an autonomous agent.

expires_in.description: Seconds until access_token expiry. Default 900 (15 minutes).

session_id.description: Server-assigned session identifier for log correlation.
